build.note: Ice time × production per 60 minutes, both recency-weighted and blended with a position average, then scaled by how many goals the opponent allows compared with the league. Then adjusted for how he has done against our own forecasts: 530 points against 468 forecast in his earlier games, shrunk toward no adjustment. The model then turns this average into the chance of each count.

assessment.price_case: This is the main 1.5 line at +135, requiring roughly a 3-in-7 chance. Consensus from two other books sits slightly under break-even, so the market prices this about fair. Value requires the model's higher rate to survive Point's absence. Settlement rules are assumed, not checked against this book.

qualitative_review.countercase: Point's absence could funnel more puck touches and top power-play time to Kucherov, keeping his usage high. Buffalo's uncertain goalie pairing could also add scoring. If the model's sample already includes games without Point, the over at +135 might still hold value.

discovery.hypothesis: Tampa Bay put Brayden Point on injured reserve with no timeline, and 20-year-old O'Reilly could make his NHL debut. Tampa also plays at Columbus on Thursday, so tonight is the first night of a back-to-back. CBS listed Buffalo as a slight home underdog (+106, total 6.5). If the current price hasn't moved enough to account for Point's absence, Buffalo is worth a look. Puck drop is listed for 7:10 PM EST Wednesday, but outlets disagree: NHL.com says 7 p.m. ET and ESPN says 7:30 PM.
discovery.question: Has the line already moved to account for Point being out? Who are the confirmed starting goalies? Does Tampa's lineup without Point actually leave its top six much weaker?

assessment.model_case: No probability can be endorsed. The earlier unqualified forecast was near even, and the lagged regulation goal rates show nearly identical teams. Whether those rates reflect Tampa without Point is unknown.
assessment.price_case: This is a single moneyline with no alternate ladder. At +110, break-even is slightly under even money, and the market sits close to that level. The unverified CBS +106 note implies small drift, not clear mispricing.
assessment.context_case: Point's IR listing is sourced. The back-to-back, debut and start-time claims are not. Buffalo also lists goalie Lyon on IR, and both starting goalies remain projected.

qualitative_review.countercase: Point was listed by Nov 10, so the price has likely absorbed his absence already. Buffalo's own listed absences offset part of Tampa's loss, and a Vasilevskiy start would blunt the angle. The case rests on an unverified narrative rather than a qualified model price.
